description.p: OpenSound is a non-profit, community-made application for Linux. It lets you control noise cancelling, the equalizer, multipoint, automatic power off and other settings of WH-1000XM5 headphones, and shows the battery level and the active codec.
It exists because there is no official way to configure these headphones from Linux. OpenSound is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony.
Power off the headphones from the app or the GNOME Shell extension.
The GNOME Shell extension adds a top-bar control card with the battery level, noise control, ambient level and focus on voice.
Rewrite in Rust, confirmation dialogs for disruptive changes, Fedora RPM packages.
